name: vibereel
description: Turn your latest Claude Code or Codex session into a 30-second shareable film.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/player && cp src/player/client.js src/player/player.css dist/player/ && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js --file fixtures/demo-dark-mode.jsonl --out assets/demo.html --gif --mp4

author: Tanbir Hossain Ramim
